title: Zaffer Zaffs

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Look who it is, finest noodle tout in the LUZ.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look who it is, finest noodle tout in the LUZ.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Look who it is, my favorite Corpster.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look who it is, my favorite Corpster.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Well, old Banor ain't bad for his age, but he’s not really my type.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, old Banor ain't bad for his age, but he’s not really my type.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Let's just say I know what I like, and I like what I see.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's just say I know what I like, and I like what I see.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Could’ve fooled me. Look at this place. Colorless as ‘Sec agent’s skivvies.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Could’ve fooled me. Look at this place. Colorless as ‘Sec agent’s skivvies.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Chronic. Why don’t you just change your sign to say “‘Sec Only”?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Chronic. Why don’t you just change your sign to say “‘Sec Only”?

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Nothing today, officer. Zaff ya later.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing today, officer. Zaff ya later.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Ha, mellow out, mate. Said I could zaff your gaff. The offer still stands.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha, mellow out, mate. Said I could zaff your gaff. The offer still stands.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: I came by to glom your place. And not a moment too soon. Look at it, colorless as ‘Sec agent’s skivvies.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I came by to glom your place. And not a moment too soon. Look at it, colorless as ‘Sec agent’s skivvies.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Came by to glom your place. And not a moment too soon. Look at it, colorless as ‘Sec agent’s skivvies.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Came by to glom your place. And not a moment too soon. Look at it, colorless as ‘Sec agent’s skivvies.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Bit of neon-twisting here, dash of screw-you-CorpSec there. Trust me, it’ll be grand.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bit of neon-twisting here, dash of screw-you-CorpSec there. Trust me, it’ll be grand.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: This is Nivalis, mate. Trouble’s gonna get you whether you do what they say or not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is Nivalis, mate. Trouble’s gonna get you whether you do what they say or not.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Sweet. Course, I’m gonna need some neon. I’m all out. Traded my good shit for tools to create my last masterpiece.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sweet. Course, I’m gonna need some neon. I’m all out. Traded my good shit for tools to create my last masterpiece.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Go see my Aunt Mertie in the market. Mention my name. She knows what I like.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Go see my Aunt Mertie in the market. Mention my name. She knows what I like.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Huckstash’s crew. He’s a radical old goat. In both senses of the words, know what I mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huckstash’s crew. He’s a radical old goat. In both senses of the words, know what I mean?

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Lemme put it this way: if the Lapin is the demi god of artpunks, then Huckstash is like, the king of freighthoppers. One of the greatest of all time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lemme put it this way: if the Lapin is the demi god of artpunks, then Huckstash is like, the king of freighthoppers. One of the greatest of all time.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Ha ha, mate. If you gotta ask, you ain’t punk enough for the ‘Stash. Zaff ya later.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha ha, mate. If you gotta ask, you ain’t punk enough for the ‘Stash. Zaff ya later.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Never far from a train. Crusties got steel in the blood. Zaff ya later.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never far from a train. Crusties got steel in the blood. Zaff ya later.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: I would have said pay a visit to my Aunt Mertie but...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I would have said pay a visit to my Aunt Mertie but...

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Thanks. She was one of the best of us, you know? Can you find Neon Tubes for me? Hive Mall could be a good place to start.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks. She was one of the best of us, you know? Can you find Neon Tubes for me? Hive Mall could be a good place to start.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: One of them, yeah. If the Lapin is the demi god of artpunks, then Huckstash is like, the king of freighthoppers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: One of them, yeah. If the Lapin is the demi god of artpunks, then Huckstash is like, the king of freighthoppers.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I’m not a Corpster.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’m not a Corpster.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you talking about me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you talking about me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What can I do for you today?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What can I do for you today?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What can I do for you today?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What can I do for you today?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what is your type?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what is your type?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I haven’t had it long.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I haven’t had it long.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I like it this way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like it this way.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is there anything else you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is there anything else you want?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Is there anything else you want?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Is there anything else you want?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you just came by to look?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you just came by to look?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And you just came by to look?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And you just came by to look?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Zaff it how, exactly?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Zaff it how, exactly?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks, but no. I can’t afford to get into trouble.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks, but no. I can’t afford to get into trouble.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Thanks, but no. I can’t afford to get into trouble.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Thanks, but no. I can’t afford to get into trouble.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let’s do it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let’s do it!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where can I get some?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where can I get some?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Leave it with me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Leave it with me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think I know what I like too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think I know what I like too.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think I know what I like too.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think I know what I like too.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks, Zaffer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks, Zaffer.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you ever heard of the Crusty Punks?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you ever heard of the Crusty Punks?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Have you ever heard of the Crusty Punks?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Have you ever heard of the Crusty Punks?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not really?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not really?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where can I find him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where can I find him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sorry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: See you later.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: See you later.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what do you do differently?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what do you do differently?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So what do you do differently?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So what do you do differently?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Greatest of all time?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Greatest of all time?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm ... well ... flattered?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm ... well ... flattered?
